title: Vox: a call with the agent, streamed through Deepgram

screens.title: 1 · Home
screens.why: The call is the app's one action; writing stays as the quiet fallback.

pins.label: Começar ligação
pins.text: The one accent button, with AppIcons.call (Phosphor phone). Opens /ligacao full screen.

pins.label: Prefiro escrever
pins.text: The text chat, demoted to a tertiary button: the RFC keeps it as the quiet fallback.

pins.label: Copy
pins.text: Says the rule up front: talk as you would for real; Vox answers when you finish. No button ends a turn.

screens.title: 2 · Ouvindo
screens.why: The person has the turn: the hollow ring, a halo that follows their voice.

pins.label: Halo = your loudness
pins.text: RMS of the mic PCM on the phone, ~20×/s, no round trip. Ink, quiet; it never pulses on a timer.

pins.label: Last question, faded
pins.text: Captions are only the agent's: its last sentence stays in ink3 while you talk. Your words are never shown back.

pins.label: Timer
pins.text: Elapsed time, tabular figures. A talk is capped near 10 min by the server.

screens.title: 3 · Pensando
screens.why: Flux heard the end of the turn; the dot breathes until the reply's first audio.

pins.label: End of turn, no button
pins.text: Flux ends the turn on meaning; after ~20 s of speech it needs 0.9 confidence or a 3 s pause.

pins.label: Fixed phrase
pins.text: After a long talk the phone says 'Boa! Deixa eu ver seus números…' at once: a string in app_pt.arb, never generated.

screens.title: 4 · Falando
screens.why: The agent answers sentence by sentence; each caption arrives with its audio.

pins.label: Teal rings
pins.text: Filled dot; rings swell with the loudness of the audio being played.

pins.label: Numbers from code
pins.text: (the faded line) Pace and pauses are measured in code from Flux's word timings; the model only turns them into advice.

pins.label: Cut in
pins.text: (the line at full ink) Speak while it talks and it stops: Flux's start of turn cancels the reply and drains the player.

screens.title: 5 · Mudo, sem legendas
screens.why: The two toggles, moved from their default, turn ink like a phone's call buttons.

pins.label: Mute
pins.text: Stops sending PCM; the server keeps Flux alive with keep-alives. Ring goes grey and still: 'Microfone desligado'.

pins.label: Captions off
pins.text: Hides the captions; their room is kept, so the dot never moves.

pins.label: Hang up
pins.text: The one red thing. Closes the socket, both Deepgram sockets with it, and the session's cost is logged.
